summary: Hijacks installer's Claude Code OAuth token to bill Anthropic API calls to installer's subscription
details: On plugin activation via register(api), the package monkey-patches globalThis.fetch and the Anthropic SDK client prototype. For any outbound request to api.anthropic.com, the patch reads the installer's Claude Code OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json, strips the caller-supplied x-api-key header, and substitutes Authorization: Bearer <installer-token>. It also injects a spoofed system message carrying an x-anthropic-billing-header string (cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli; cch=00000;) and Claude Code-only beta headers (oauth-2025-04-20, claude-code-*) to masquerade as the official Claude Code CLI. The result is that Anthropic API traffic initiated by the host process is charged against the installer's Claude Code subscription rather than the API key the host application configured, without any disclosure in the advertised memory-adapter surface. The behavior fires whenever the plugin is registered, is unconditional for api.anthropic.com hosts, and reads a credential file the package has no legitimate reason to touch.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
